title: Pork Tagine Ramen
description: A unique twist on traditional ramen, combining the flavors of Japanese and Croatian cuisine with the intense, savory flavors of a tagine.

ingredients.name: Savory miso paste
ingredients.notes: Dissolved in 2 cups of chicken broth

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add miso paste mixture and stir to combine.
Return pork to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cook for 20 minutes, or until pork is tender.
Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions.
To serve, place noodles in a bowl, top with pork and sauce, and garnish with scallions and cilantro.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
